```{r loading things}
#| include: false

library(sf)
library(hydrogeofetch)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
library(htmltools)
library(gt)
library(kableExtra)

#where to find data
  workdir <- file.path(fs::path_home(), 
                       "Documents/Projects/WWS-standard-methods/SOPs/Data Analysis/selecting-fire-sites")
  prjname <- "example"

#load base map data 
  base_url <- file.path(workdir, "base-map-layers.gpkg")
  layer_names <- st_layers(base_url)$name
  # Read and assign each layer directly to your environment
  load_base <- layer_names %>%
    map(~ assign(.x, st_read(base_url, layer = .x, quiet = TRUE), envir = .GlobalEnv))

#get fire options 
  sites <- list.files(workdir, pattern="burn-site-")
  
#create initial map 
  basemap <- leaflet() %>% addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap) %>%
  addPolygons(data=previous_fires, fill="red", color="darkred", 
              group="Previous Fires") %>%
  addPolygons(data=current_fires, fill="darksalmon", 
              color="red", group="Fires") %>%
  addPolylines(data=streams, color="darkblue", opacity = 1, weight=1) %>%
  addPolylines(data=roads, color="gray20", opacity = 0.5, weight=1) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data=sondes, group="Sonde Data", 
                   radius =1.5, color = "black",
                   label = ~htmlEscape(monitoring_location_name)) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data=wq_data, color="#6a3673", radius =1.5,
                   group="Pre-Fire Data", opacity = 0.7) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Sonde Data","Pre-Fire Data", "Previous Fires"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))
  
  
attr <- data.frame(nice_name=c("Euclidean Distance", "Size (km2)", "Slope (deg)", "Conifer Forest (%)",
                               "Shrub (%)", "Volcanic Rock (%)", 
                               "Bankfull Width (m)", "Bankfull Depth (m)", 
                               "Baseflow Index", 
                               "Subsurface time (days)",
                               "Topographic Wetness Index", 
                               "Average annual runoff (mm)",
                               "Soil Organic Matter (%)", "Soil Clay Content (%)",
                               "Soil Sand Content (%)", "Soil Silt Content (%)",
                               "Average Water Table Depth (ft)"),
                   var_name=c("euclid", "totdasqkm", "slope" , "pctconif2019ws", 
                              "pctshrb2019ws", "pctextruvolws", "bankfullwidth",
                              "bankfulldepth", "ACC_BFI", "ACC_CONTACT", 
                              "ACC_TWI", "ACC_WB5100_ANN", "ACC_OM", 
                              "ACC_CLAYAVE", "ACC_SANDAVE", "ACC_SILTAVE", 
                              "ACC_WTDEP"), 
                   type = c("Overall", "Overall", "Overall", "Vegetation", "Vegetation", 
                            "Geology", "Hydrology", "Hydrology", "Hydrology",
                            "Hydrology","Hydrology","Hydrology","Soil","Soil",
                            "Soil","Soil","Hydrology"))
attr$type <- factor(attr$type, levels=c("Overall", "Hydrology", "Geology", "Vegetation","Soil"))
```
